svg.text: Galaxy cluster: five Proxmox VE 9.2.11 nodes
No shared storage and no HA groups. Corosync link0 rides MGMT-A (VLAN 70), link1 rides Cluster-Net (VLAN 71)
purple and green not on it
Guest addresses are the VLAN-side interfaces. win11-dev moved from green to grey on 2026-09-23; green-server carries no guests until its memory errors are resolved.
Source: Infrastructure/Hardware/Nodes.md, Operations/Inventory/Galaxy/VMs.md and LXCs.md, Infrastructure/Hardware/Power.md
